title: cathay Corrupted Shenzoo
author: PassingByPosts
description:
ALPHA RELEASE 0.04

-- The Alpha Release is now live. This version is very experimental but is open to play and give feedback on the discord

-- I wanted to let me people play with it over xmas so enjoy whats available

-- This is a very experimental release so expect issues and bugs

Overview

This mod introduces and explores what happened to Shen-zoo the dragon of light and hope mentioned in the realms of chaos campaign as the lost dragon they are looking for.

This introduces a new dragon to play as Cathay stuck and lost in the barren North far away from home will she achieve her goals and make it home or end up corrupted and lost to cathay forever?

How do i begin the mod?

[[SPOILER]]

This mod begins from the main menu and you can find Shenzoo under the Cathay banner in immortal empires (Realms of Chaos is unsupported)

At the start of the campaign the follwing is ready to test and play

-
Find a home

-
Find your first companion and talk to them in a brand new faction mechanic

-
Fight a custom quest battle (Courtest of Kerberos)

-
Free your second companion

[[/SPOILER]]

- it should be BELOW Shenzoo in mod order

Currently no variants ready

[[SPOILER]]

Placeholder for variant model gif when options available

[[/SPOILER]]

-
This launch version has the building chains in a separate pack, so you can play Shenzoo as a normal cathay faction but the real intent is to use the alternate buiilding chain in the future to give her the long march home mechanic.

Conflicts

Warhammer 3 only allows one esl file per game so only one mod that touches the faction editor can work. So this mod will most likely not work with any mod adding in other factions

[[/SPOILER]]

F.A.Q

How i download the mod?

[[SPOILER]]

press the download button

[[/SPOILER]]

How do i install this mod?

[[SPOILER]]

place the pak file in your warhammer 3 data folder and enable it in the games mod maanger

Your data folder is normally found in this file path ;

You should always ensure any zipped files are unpacked

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Total War WARHAMMER III\data

[[/SPOILER]]

I used the cheat sheet to fire a dilemma but my model didnt change?

[[SPOILER]]

Model changes are based on the tracking variable that will fire dilemma's when it detects a block change.

Firing dilemmas via console will only give you text

You would need to change the variable number
